answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model on the multilingual retrieval benchmark MIR-ACL... and use nDCG@10 and Recall@100 as evaluation metrics.

answer_3.quote: To achieve this, we leverage a large language model LLM to judge each candidate document... via a designed prompt to produce three granularity of relevance...

answer_4.quote: For each language, we randomly sample 100 false negatives for human validation with three annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluate how well the Candidate Answer addresses key aspects... and accuracy with three-level rating (0/1/2).
